method: 取象法 via /meihua-yishu skill; displaced 取象法 controls (see protocol_batch4.md + amendment_01)
note: Outcome definitions written BEFORE casting. source_confidence: 'verified' = date confirmed by web search 2026-07-26; 'inferred' = recurring/scheduled event whose exact date or format was not separately confirmed. Events that do not resolve inside the window are DROPPED, not replaced (protocol stop rule).

events.title_en: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 — final medal table
events.title_zh: 格拉斯哥大英國協運動會 — 最終獎牌榜
events.description: The scaled-down Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games close on 2 August after 11 days across four venues in an eight-mile corridor, with a 10-sport programme and a fully integrated Para programme.
events.binary_outcome: Australia finishes top of the overall gold-medal table.

events.title_en: Commonwealth Games — host nation Scotland's gold haul
events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會 — 地主蘇格蘭金牌數
events.description: Scotland competes as host for the second time in 12 years, in a Games it agreed to rescue at short notice after other bidders withdrew.
events.binary_outcome: Scotland wins 10 or more gold medals.

events.title_en: Commonwealth Games athletics — closing night relays
events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會田徑 — 閉幕夜接力
events.description: Athletics runs 27 July to 1 August at Scotstoun. The closing night carries both 4x100m relay finals, the men's 5,000m, both One Mile finals, the men's 800m and the mixed 4x400m relay.
events.binary_outcome: England wins the men's 4x100m relay final.

events.title_en: Commonwealth Games boxing — gold medal bouts
events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會拳擊 — 金牌賽
events.description: Boxing semi-finals are held on Friday 31 July with all gold medal bouts on Saturday 1 August.
events.binary_outcome: India wins 3 or more boxing gold medals.

events.title_en: Commonwealth Games track cycling at the Sir Chris Hoy Velodrome
events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會場地自行車
events.description: Track cycling runs 30 July to 2 August at the velodrome named for Scotland's own six-time Olympic champion, with Para track cycling fully integrated into the medal programme.
events.binary_outcome: Australia wins the men's team pursuit gold.

events.description: Judo is contested from 31 July to 2 August, returning to the programme after being absent from the previous Games.
events.binary_outcome: England wins more judo gold medals than Scotland.

events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會 3x3 籃球決賽
events.description: All four 3x3 tournaments — men's, women's, and both 3x3 wheelchair events — run 24-29 July with the medal matches on 2 August.
events.binary_outcome: Australia wins the men's 3x3 basketball gold.

events.description: Swimming and Para swimming are on the 10-sport Glasgow programme, historically the event where Australia accumulates its largest single-sport gold total.
events.binary_outcome: Australia wins 15 or more swimming gold medals.

events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會英式籃球決賽
events.description: Netball, one of the 10 retained sports, decides its gold medal on the final day. Australia, New Zealand and England have shared every Commonwealth title.
events.binary_outcome: Australia wins the netball gold medal.

events.description: Weightlifting and Para powerlifting run through the Games. India has historically dominated the Commonwealth weightlifting programme.
events.binary_outcome: India finishes top of the weightlifting gold-medal table.

events.description: The 2026 deadline falls at 6 p.m. ET on 3 August, moved off the traditional 31 July date under the rule letting the Commissioner set it anywhere from 28 July to 3 August.
events.binary_outcome: A player with at least one career All-Star selection changes teams on deadline day.

events.description: The two weeks after the deadline are when reshaped rosters first show whether a contender bought well or bought late.
events.binary_outcome: The Los Angeles Dodgers lead the NL West outright at the end of play on 10 August.

events.description: Roughly 200 regular-season games are played between 27 July and 10 August, the stretch where late-summer pitching peaks meet worn-down lineups.
events.binary_outcome: At least one no-hitter (individual or combined) is thrown between 27 July and 10 August.

events.title_en: UEFA Champions League third qualifying round, first legs
events.title_zh: 歐冠第三輪資格賽首回合
events.description: The third qualifying round is played 4/5 and 11 August. Clubs from smaller leagues meet sides that failed to qualify directly, with the away goal long since abolished and every tie decided over two legs.
events.binary_outcome: At least one first leg ends with the lower-ranked (by UEFA club coefficient) side winning away from home.

events.title_en: NFL Hall of Fame Game, Canton
events.description: The NFL preseason opens on Thursday 6 August in Canton, Ohio with the Carolina Panthers facing the Arizona Cardinals at 8:00pm ET on NBC — a game played almost entirely by roster hopefuls.
events.binary_outcome: The Carolina Panthers win the Hall of Fame Game.

events.description: The Toronto Masters 1000 runs 2-12 August on hard court, the first big test of the North American summer swing.
events.binary_outcome: The No. 1 seed is still in the draw at the end of play on 10 August.

events.title_en: WNBA restart after the All-Star break
events.description: The WNBA All-Star break ran 23-27 July around the All-Star Game at the United Center. Teams return to a compressed second half.
events.binary_outcome: The Las Vegas Aces win their first game after the All-Star break.

events.title_zh: 大英國協運動會競技體操
events.description: Artistic gymnastics is among the 10 sports retained for the reduced Glasgow programme, concentrated into a short window of apparatus and all-around finals.
events.binary_outcome: England wins the men's all-around gold medal.

events.title_en: FOMC July decision and Powell press conference
events.description: The FOMC meets 28-29 July, releasing its statement at 2:00pm ET on the 29th with a press conference at 2:30pm. No updated projections or dot plot accompany this meeting.
events.binary_outcome: The target range for the federal funds rate is left unchanged.

events.description: Apple reports in the final week of July, the densest week of the Q2 2026 season, with the mega-cap technology names clustered together.
events.binary_outcome: Apple reports EPS above the consensus estimate.

events.description: Microsoft reports in the same cluster, with cloud and AI capital expenditure the line investors read first.
events.binary_outcome: Microsoft reports EPS above the consensus estimate.

events.description: Amazon reports in the peak week; the market reaction typically hinges on AWS growth and forward guidance rather than the headline number.
events.binary_outcome: Amazon reports revenue above the consensus estimate.

events.title_en: Meta quarterly earnings and next-day stock reaction
events.description: Meta reports in the last week of July. Its post-earnings moves have repeatedly been double-digit in either direction as spending plans are re-priced.
events.binary_outcome: Meta's share price closes higher on the first full trading day after the report than on the day before it.

events.title_zh: 美國七月非農就業報告
events.description: The July nonfarm payrolls report is released on the first Friday of August, a week after the Fed meets and with no intervening projections.
events.binary_outcome: Headline nonfarm payroll growth comes in above the consensus forecast.

events.description: Crypto trades through the Fed decision, the mega-cap earnings cluster and the jobs report inside a single fortnight.
events.binary_outcome: Bitcoin's price on 10 August is higher than its price on 27 July.

events.description: The index enters the window with earnings season at its peak and the Fed decision unresolved.
events.binary_outcome: The S&P 500 sets at least one new all-time closing high between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Gold's move across the window reads as the market's summary judgement on rates and risk.
events.binary_outcome: Spot gold closes higher on 10 August than on 27 July.

events.title_en: US 10-year Treasury yield over the window
events.title_zh: 美國十年期公債殖利率
events.description: The long end absorbs the Fed statement, the refunding calendar and the jobs print in the same fortnight.
events.binary_outcome: The 10-year Treasury yield is lower on 10 August than on 27 July.

events.description: Guam holds its primary on 1 August, the first of the August primary wave, choosing nominees including for its non-voting congressional delegate.
events.binary_outcome: The incumbent delegate wins their party's primary.

events.title_zh: 密西根聯邦參議員民主黨初選
events.description: Michigan holds both party primaries for its US Senate seat on 4 August, a contest that will shape one of November's most-watched general elections.
events.binary_outcome: The candidate leading in the final pre-primary public polling average wins the Democratic primary.

events.description: Michigan's open governor's race reaches its primary on 4 August, with both parties selecting nominees for an open seat.
events.binary_outcome: The Republican gubernatorial primary is decided by more than 10 percentage points.

events.description: Missouri votes on 4 August for US House, state Senate and statewide nominations.
events.binary_outcome: Every incumbent US House member seeking renomination in Missouri wins their primary.

events.description: Kansas holds its primary on 4 August, including nominations for an open governor's race.
events.binary_outcome: The Republican candidate with the most establishment endorsements wins the gubernatorial primary.

events.description: Washington runs its all-party top-two primary on 4 August, where all candidates appear on one ballot and the top two advance regardless of party.
events.binary_outcome: A Democrat finishes first in the top-two primary for Washington's US Senate seat.

events.description: Tennessee votes on Thursday 6 August, keeping its unusual weekday-not-Tuesday primary tradition.
events.binary_outcome: Every incumbent US House member seeking renomination in Tennessee wins their primary.

events.description: Hawaii holds its primary on Saturday 8 August, the last of the primaries inside this window.
events.binary_outcome: The incumbent governor wins the Democratic gubernatorial primary.

events.title_en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day opening weekend
events.title_zh: 蜘蛛人：全新一天 首週末
events.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day releases 31 July in the US and Australia, the summer's largest superhero opening and a franchise reset after the previous trilogy's finale.
events.binary_outcome: It finishes #1 at the domestic box office for its opening weekend.

events.title_en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day opening gross
events.title_zh: 蜘蛛人：全新一天 開票房
events.description: Tracking for a franchise reset carries unusually wide error bars: the character is proven, the configuration is new.
events.binary_outcome: Domestic opening weekend gross exceeds $150 million.

events.title_en: Second weekend of August at the box office
events.description: August openers including Buddy, Mutiny, Coyote vs. ACME, The Dog Stars and The End of Oak Street enter against an incumbent blockbuster.
events.binary_outcome: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is still #1 domestically for the weekend of 7-9 August.

events.title_zh: 芝加哥 Lollapalooza 音樂節
events.description: Lollapalooza runs 30 July to 2 August in Grant Park, a four-day festival with a long history of mid-set weather evacuations.
events.binary_outcome: The festival completes all four days without a full-grounds weather evacuation.

events.description: Summer chart weeks are where a song either consolidates a long run or is displaced by a release timed to the season.
events.binary_outcome: The #1 song on the Hot 100 chart dated 8 August is the same as on the chart dated 1 August.

events.description: The album chart in early August is typically decided by whether a major release lands in the tracking week.
events.binary_outcome: The #1 album on the Billboard 200 chart dated 8 August is a new entry.

events.description: Netflix publishes weekly viewing hours; the top slot alternates between new releases and back-catalogue resurgences driven by social media.
events.binary_outcome: The most-watched English-language title for the week of 3-9 August is a title released within the prior 30 days.

events.description: Buddy is among the wide releases opening in the first half of August, in the shadow of a Marvel tentpole.
events.binary_outcome: Buddy opens above $20 million domestically.

events.description: Black Hat USA runs 1-6 August at Mandalay Bay, opening with four days of trainings and closing with two days of Briefings. AI security is expected to dominate: prompt injection at scale, model supply chain attacks, and the security properties of agentic systems.
events.binary_outcome: At least one Briefing discloses a named, previously undisclosed vulnerability in a commercially deployed LLM or AI agent product.

events.description: DEF CON follows Black Hat in the same Las Vegas week — the highest-density technical week in the security calendar, with its village format producing the results that reach mainstream press.
events.binary_outcome: A DEF CON village result receives coverage in at least one mainstream (non-trade) national news outlet.

events.title_en: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 retail availability
events.title_zh: 三星 Z Fold 8 上市
events.description: Galaxy Unpacked was held 22 July, announcing the Z Fold 8 at $1,899, the Z Fold 8 Ultra at $2,099 and the Z Flip 8 at $1,199, with pre-orders opening at the close of the keynote and general availability expected in early August.
events.binary_outcome: General retail availability begins on or before 10 August with no announced delay.

events.description: The major labs have been shipping on a compressed cadence, and the Las Vegas security week tends to attract adjacent announcements.
events.binary_outcome: At least one of OpenAI, Anthropic or Google DeepMind publicly releases a new flagship model between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Two weeks of peak summer load across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, overlapping the security conference week.
events.binary_outcome: At least one of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud publicly acknowledges an outage lasting two hours or more affecting a major region.

events.description: Nvidia does not report in this window but trades on everyone else's capital expenditure disclosures during the peak earnings week.
events.binary_outcome: Nvidia closes higher on 10 August than on 27 July.

events.description: US and EU processes on AI oversight have both been running to timetables that produce announcements through the summer.
events.binary_outcome: A new binding AI regulatory measure or formal enforcement action is announced by a US federal agency or the EU between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Apple is expected to announce new iPhones in September, reportedly including its first foldable, roughly eight weeks after Samsung's July keynote. Invitations historically go out in late August.
events.binary_outcome: Apple publicly announces the date of its September event on or before 10 August.

events.title_zh: CRS-35 國際太空站補給任務
events.description: CRS-35 will deliver supplies and science to the International Space Station, scheduled no earlier than August 2026. Launch dates in this programme move frequently on weather and readiness.
events.binary_outcome: CRS-35 launches on or before 10 August.

events.description: SpaceX has sustained a launch cadence measured in days rather than weeks, spread across Cape Canaveral, Kennedy and Vandenberg.
events.binary_outcome: SpaceX conducts 8 or more Falcon 9 launches between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Starship test campaigns proceed in bursts separated by regulatory review and pad turnaround, making any specific two-week window genuinely uncertain.
events.binary_outcome: A Starship integrated flight test occurs between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Late July into August is when Atlantic activity conventionally accelerates toward the September peak.
events.binary_outcome: At least one new named Atlantic tropical storm forms between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Magnitude 7.0+ events occur globally at a long-run average of roughly one per month, distributed without pattern.
events.binary_outcome: At least one magnitude 7.0 or greater earthquake occurs worldwide between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: The solar cycle remains active enough that strong storms and visible aurora at mid-latitudes have become recurrent news events.
events.binary_outcome: NOAA observes a G3 (strong) or greater geomagnetic storm between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Early August is climatologically the hottest fortnight of the northern year, and recent summers have repeatedly produced national all-time records.
events.binary_outcome: At least one country sets a new national all-time high temperature record between 27 July and 10 August.

events.description: Agency schedules across crewed and flagship science programmes have been under sustained pressure from budget and hardware readiness.
events.binary_outcome: NASA or ESA publicly announces a delay to a major mission milestone between 27 July and 10 August.
